summary.text: Jason Perron is an unenrolled candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives 3rd Hampden District in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Republican Nicholas Boldyga and Democrat Thomas Hendrickson.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a veteran and a police officer with nearly 30 years of law enforcement experience.

paragraphs.text: Jason Perron served in the U.S. Air Force from 1993 to 1998, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a high school diploma from Southwick High School and a bachelor's degree from Ashworth College in 2020, and his career experience includes working as a law enforcement officer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Perron said he is a former chair of the Southwick Selectboard and a longtime union steward and contract negotiator.

He said he is running as an independent and listed affordability, local aid, public safety, education, government accountability, infrastructure and fair attention for Western Massachusetts among his policy interests.
